name: breadcrumb-item
purpose: Single segment in a breadcrumb trail. Ancestor segments use muted label text and optional leading icon; the current page uses default text. Hover and focus-visible states match the Azion UI navigation pattern (ghost overlay + focus ring).
useWhen: Use Breadcrumb.Item only as a part of Breadcrumb; for the page trail itself use Breadcrumb.
Composing a breadcrumb trail by hand inside `Breadcrumb.List`, one segment per ancestor plus the current page.
A single ancestor or current-page segment that must match the breadcrumb's muted / current styling and focus ring.
avoidWhen: The whole trail is known as data → use `breadcrumb` with `items`, which renders the segments for you.
It is a standalone text link in content or a page footer → use `link`.
It is a navigation row in an app menu → use `sidebar-menu`.
related: `breadcrumb` — the trail root; renders `breadcrumb-item` for each entry of `items` and re-exports it as `Breadcrumb.Item`.
`link` — a general-purpose link without the segment's ghost hover and current-page treatment.
bestPractices: Set `active` on the last segment only; it renders a `span` with `aria-current="page"`, drops out of the tab order and ignores `href`.
Always pass a real `href` on ancestors — an empty `href` (the default) renders `#`, and the segment renders an `a`.
Use `show-icon` together with `icon` (an Azion icon class; empty shows `az az-box`); `icon` alone renders nothing.
`disabled` suppresses the `click` emit and removes the segment from the tab order; prefer omitting an unreachable ancestor over disabling it.

props.name: href
props.doc: Destination when the segment is a link (ignored when `active` is true); empty renders `#`.

props.name: active
props.doc: Marks the current page (last segment); renders as span with `aria-current="page"`.

props.name: showIcon
props.doc: When true, renders a leading icon before the label.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Azion icon class for the leading icon when `showIcon` is true; empty shows `az az-box`.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables interaction and applies disabled tokens.

events.name: click
events.payload: (event: MouseEvent, item: { label: string; href: string })
events.notes: Fires when the segment's link is activated (the `active` segment renders a non-interactive `span`). `item` carries the segment's `label` and `href`.
